description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2062/24, Homagama D/S Division and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains specific details about parcels of land, cadastral maps, village locations, Grama Niladhari divisions, and amendments to land title records including servitude rights, village name corrections, extent measurements, and owner address/identity card updates. The content falls squarely under Land Gazettes as it concerns land registrations, property ownership details, and title amendments.
